2609.34591.title: TULIP: Targeted LLM Unlearning at Layers Identified Per-Input
2609.34591.paper_summary: Representation-level unlearning intervenes on the intermediate hidden states of LLMs. Although knowledge is distributed across layers, existing methods operate at a single fixed layer for the entire forget set. We ask whether such a fixed layer is sufficient. To answer this, we design a hijacking experiment that grafts hidden states of the target model into an oracle trained only on the retain set. The oracle cannot produce the forget answer on its own, yet it produces the answer from the grafted state. Thus, the answer is formed at an intermediate layer and merely read out afterward, so unlearning should focus on formation, not readout. Moreover, the layer where formation ends varies widely across inputs. Motivated by these findings, we propose Targeted Unlearning at Layers Identified Per-input (TULIP). For each input, TULIP uses the logit lens to locate the formation-readout boundary and removes the hidden state's alignment with the forget answer's unembedding vector there. TULIP consistently outperforms output- and representation-level baselines on TOFU, PISTOL, and WMDP across Llama, Qwen, and Zephyr models. It also remains robust to paraphrase and quantization attacks. Beyond standalone use, its per-input layer selection serves as a plug-and-play component that further improves existing methods.
2609.34591.paper_summary_zh: 表示層級的遺忘介入了大型語言模型（LLMs）的中間隱藏狀態。雖然知識分佈在各層之間，但現有的方法對整個遺忘集僅在單一固定層運作。我們質疑這樣的固定層是否足夠。為了回答這個問題，我們設計了一個劫持實驗，將目標模型的隱藏狀態移植到僅在保留集上訓練的神諭模型中。該神諭模型無法自行產生遺忘答案，但它可以從移植的狀態中產生答案。因此，答案是在中間層形成的，並且僅在之後被讀出，因此遺忘應該專注於形成，而不是讀出。此外，形成結束的層在不同輸入之間差異很大。基於這些發現，我們提出了每個輸入識別層的目標化遺忘（TULIP）。對於每個輸入，TULIP使用邏輯透鏡來定位形成-讀出邊界，並在那裡移除隱藏狀態與遺忘答案的去嵌入向量之間的對齊。TULIP在Llama、Qwen和Zephyr模型的TOFU、PISTOL和WMDP上始終優於輸出和表示層級的基準。此外，它對於同義改寫和量化攻擊仍然保持穩健。除了單獨使用外，其每個輸入的層選擇還作為即插即用的組件，進一步改善現有方法。
